## Copilot Instructions for helia-blockchain

- This project uses Node.js, TypeScript, Hardhat, and Helia.
- Helia is an ES Module, so ensure all imports and configurations are ESM compatible.
- `package.json` has `"type": "module"`.
- `tsconfig.json` is configured for ES2022 modules and `node16` module resolution.
- Hardhat is configured with `@nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox`.
- The main application code should reside in the `src` directory.
- The entry point is `src/index.ts`.
